language.label: Language
language.description: The language Razor Reaper's interface is shown in. Pages that have not been translated yet stay English.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Appearance, audio and app behaviour. Hotkeys live on their own page.
settings.account.title: My account
settings.account.description: Your profile picture, Discord account and connected computers.
settings.appearance.title: Appearance
settings.appearance.description: The accent recolours the whole app — every surface reads it from one variable.
settings.scale.title: Interface scale
settings.scale.description: Scales every element. Useful on very high or very low resolutions.
settings.behaviour.title: App behaviour
settings.behaviour.description: How Razor Reaper behaves alongside ARK and Discord.
settings.discord.title: Discord Rich Presence
settings.discord.description: Shows your current tool and version on your Discord profile.
settings.startwithark.title: Start with ARK
settings.startwithark.description: A lightweight watcher launches Razor Reaper as soon as ARK starts.
settings.closewithark.title: Close with ARK
settings.closewithark.description: Exits Razor Reaper when ARK closes.
settings.updates.title: Updates
settings.updates.description: Updates install themselves and restart the app. There is no opt-out.
settings.elsewhere.title: Elsewhere
settings.elsewhere.description: Settings that have a page of their own.
settings.hotkeys.title: Global hotkeys
settings.hotkeys.description: Every system-wide hotkey, in one place.
settings.gamma.title: Gamma triggers
settings.gamma.description: Gamma supports mouse buttons and Logitech G HUB, so its triggers are configured on its own page.
